title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 90 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 90 - Deduction from Payment in Respect of Services If a specified amount of money is paid by a specified person to a resident for any service, the person responsible for the payment shall deduct tax at a rate not exceeding 20% (twenty percent), at the time of payment. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail. Moreover, as per Section 345(2) of the Income Tax Act 2023, if there is a conflict between the English and Bengali text, the Bengali text shall prevail.
